name: research-mapping
description: The Project Owner's adjudication surface for Research Mapping: read the formal graph and any candidate, author a candidate when a route must continue, preview, obtain the merge-request buffer, record the review, then formalize or reconcile.
notes: list_reviewable_candidates is absent on purpose: it is the Centre Agent's whole-domain snapshot read. The Owner reads named candidates and never holds the centre tier, because holding it would let one call sweep every candidate of a domain at once and turn adjudication into pre-review.

preview_candidate alone changes nothing and returns a preview_id that no buffer tool accepts. create_merge_request is the step that turns a preview into the buffer_id that record_review and formalize_candidate consume. Skipping it is how a release stalls with a preview and no request.

record_review(decision=approved) is necessary but not sufficient: formalize_candidate re-checks the approval actor against the domain's Project Owner list, so an approval recorded by someone else is refused with owner_approval_required.

reconcile_formalization resumes the same operation_id after a half-finished activation. Do not retry with a fresh operation_id: that is a second formalization, not a retry, and it is refused by the operation-identity check.

submit_candidate is here because a continuing route needs new TaskNode / DependencyEdge candidates authored by the Owner. It is not a second path around pre-review: what the Owner authors still goes through the Centre Agent and comes back as a candidate.

tools.name: get_formal_mapping
tools.description: Read the current formal Research Mapping graph for a domain. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: get_formal_mapping_at_revision
tools.description: Read the exact formal Research Mapping snapshot pinned by a specific formal_revision_id (historical activated revision), using the same consistency gates as the current pointer read. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: list_candidates
tools.description: Read the candidate record associated with a submission. Requires the read or centre capability.

tools.name: submit_candidate
tools.description: Submit a Mapping candidate change set against the exact formal base. Requires candidate_submit or centre capability.

tools.name: preview_candidate
tools.description: Build immutable diff review evidence for a fixed candidate head. Requires candidate_review or centre capability.

tools.name: create_merge_request
tools.description: Lock a ready candidate preview into a merge-request buffer and return its buffer_id. Requires candidate_review or centre capability.

tools.name: record_review
tools.description: Record a review decision for a merge-request buffer. Requires candidate_review or centre capability.

tools.name: formalize_candidate
tools.description: Promote an Owner-approved candidate through atomic SQLite activation. Requires formalize or centre capability.

tools.name: reconcile_formalization
tools.description: Resume the same formalization operation identity. Requires formalize or centre capability.
